user_question: Board keeps rebooting right after I configure the relay pin.

reference_context.title: ESP32 Series Datasheet (Espressif)
reference_context.snippet: Pins GPIO6 to GPIO11 on the ESP32-D0WD-V3/ESP32-D0WDR2-V3 chip are connected to the SPI flash integrated on the module and are not led out.

expected.root_cause: GPIO7 is one of GPIO6-11, which are wired to the module's SPI flash; reconfiguring it breaks flash access so the CPU fetches garbage (0xffffffff) and panics.
expected.fix: Use a free GPIO (e.g. GPIO4, GPIO16-33) for the relay and never touch GPIO6-11.
